verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's first-party docs cover both parts of the story: `screenshot_full_page=true` for a full-page image and `screenshot_selector` for a CSS-targeted area screenshot, with the viewport captured by default. Viewport size can also be set with `window_width`/`window_height`. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that full-page and selector screenshots work as documented.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture a screenshot of a full page or a specific selected area

citations.quote: By default it captures the viewport; use `screenshot_selector` for a CSS-scoped screenshot or `screenshot_full_page=true` for a full-page image.
Return a screenshot of a particular area of the page, targeted by a CSS selector
